notes: Verified 22 July 2026: consultation closed 16 February 2026; statutory backstop to lay draft regulations by February 2027 recorded as the event horizon.
summary: Written statement of 17 November 2025 opened consultation on the first legally binding national PM2.5 targets under the Environment (Air Quality and Soundscapes) (Wales) Act 2024: an annual mean of 10 micrograms per cubic metre and a 25 percent cut in average population exposure, both by the end of 2035. The consultation closed on 16 February 2026 and responses are under review, with the regulations to be made in 2026-27 subject to the new post-election ministers. The 2024 Act requires the draft PM2.5 target regulations to be laid within three years of its Royal Assent, so by February 2027.
title: Draft Air Quality Target Regulations for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) under the 2024 Act
